::: {#def-full-conditional}
#### Full conditional distribution

For a parameter vector $\vparam = (\param_1, \ldots, \param_K)$,
the **full conditional distribution** of the component $\param_k$
is its conditional distribution given the data and all the other components,
$\p(\param_k \mid \vparam_{-k}, \vy)$,
where $\vparam_{-k}$ denotes every component of $\vparam$ except $\param_k$.
:::
